tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek's memory-saving technology may reduce model reliability, according to new research still open per South China Morning Post.
An AI-augmented cyberattack confirmed by The Hacker News targeted WordPress and e-commerce platforms, stealing over 628,000 Ukrainian records.
Infinigence AI raised RMB 2.3 billion in Series C funding, confirmed by TechNode, achieving 40x token growth while cutting costs.
Brad Smith says the UK is best positioned to lead on global artificial intelligence safety rules, confirmed by MarketScreener.
Google DeepMind is hiring engineers to build real-world coding tests for Gemini, with salaries ranging from $550K to $1.1 million, reported by The Times of India.
Free every hour.
